results.title: P Chidambaram slams PM Modi's 'Dimagi Naxals' comment: 'New variant of abuses'
results.description: In a post on X, Chidambaram questioned the basis of the labels and asked, "Who were the urban Naxals? Who were the Andolanjeevis? Who were the tukde tukde gang?"

results.title: AMCU President says democratic government has failed working class
results.description: AMCU has stressed that it's working hard to ensure that the harsh living conditions are improved.

results.title: Village-by-laws to protect Qauia dwellers
results.description: Qauia residents are taking community action against drugs and violent behaviour through newly introduced village by-laws. Resident Apenisa Rasalase Volauvou says the community has been increasingly affected by the availability of drugs, with families and young people among those facing the consequences.
